subject: Post-discovery technical deep dive for Aurelia Systems — scheduling & MAP
body:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Lee <jenna@aurelia.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep dive follow-up

Marcus — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Team found the conversation useful. We discussed latency budget, multi-region failover, and a rough MAP (mutual action plan).

We'd like to move to a dedicated technical deep-dive (90 minutes) focused on:
- Inference topology (KV cache, batching strategies)
- Network/VPC options for Private deployment
- Observability and runbook handoff

Primary asks: can you share 2–3 possible 90-min slots next week that include an engineer and a product/solutions lead? Also attaching a first-pass MAP (Aurelia_MAP-v1.pdf) and our internal pre-call checklist.

Appreciate it — Samir

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep dive follow-up

Samir — great to meet. Thanks for the MAP — I reviewed it with Ben (solutions eng) and Marissa (CS/runbooks). We can do a 90-min deep-dive. Proposed windows (all PT):

1) Tue Sep 14, 09:00–10:30 PT
2) Tue Sep 14, 14:00–15:30 PT
3) Wed Sep 15, 08:00–09:30 PT (early slot)

Ben and I will cover topology and runtimes; Marissa will prepare the runbook/obs overview and a quick demo of the Console traces.

I attached our precall checklist and a stubbed runbook to orient your infra folks. If none of these work, tell me two times that do and I’ll ask Ben to rework his calendar. After we lock a slot I’ll send a calendar invite (Google) and an agenda.

— Marcus

Attachments: precall-checklist.md, redwood-runbook-stub.txt

---
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@aurelia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep dive follow-up

Looping in a quick note on attendee asks: if Aurelia can include a networking engineer (for VPC peering/NAT gateway questions) and a lead ML engineer who owns inference cost targets that would make the session much higher velocity. Also, please confirm whether you want us to show a short quantization and perf comparison (we can bring an MPT-variant + a 4-bit quantized baseline).

Pro tip: if you prefer a single-threaded agenda, tell us the one area to prioritize (latency SLO vs cost optimization vs Private deployment).

— Ben

---
From: Jenna Lee <jenna@aurelia.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: it@aurelia.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep dive follow-up

Thanks — appreciate the options. Quick update: Tue Sep 14 09:00 PT conflicts with our exec briefing. We can do Tue Sep 14 14:00–15:30 PT, but our ML lead (Liam) is only available Wed morning PT. Is there flexibility to split: a 60-min architecture review Tue afternoon and a hands-on perf segment Wed 08:00–09:30 PT? If Ben can do the perf demo Wed morning, that would be ideal.

We want the MAP to reflect deliverables and signoffs — I've attached an annotated version with priorities (Aurelia_MAP-v1.pdf).

— Jenna

Attachment: Aurelia_MAP-v1.pdf

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia.ai>, Jenna Lee <jenna@aurelia.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep dive follow-up — split session OK

Thanks for the note, Jenna — splitting is fine. Proposed plan:

- Tue Sep 14, 14:00–15:00 PT: Architecture & topology review (Marcus + Marissa) — calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456
- Wed Sep 15, 08:00–09:30 PT: Perf & quantization lab (Ben + Marcus) — will send separate invite for the hands-on segment.

Next steps for Aurelia: please confirm attendees for each slot (networking, ML lead, product owner). I'll update the MAP in HubSpot (see link) and add deliverables. We will prepare a short perf artifact (token-level latency histogram) for the Wed session.

If anything changes materially, let me know and we'll reschedule — otherwise I will send invites and a combined agenda by EOD.

Thanks — Marcus

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4729
